itemDB.description:
A simple, unremarkable weapon used by
Knights.

A cheap but effective piercing weapon used
by Rogues.

A holy staff bestowed to all apprentice
Clerics.

This crude wooden implement gently hums
with energy.

Interlocking metal plates create this sturdy
Knight's armor.

These weathered leather clothes offer slight
protection.

This lightweight cloak protects against the
wind and little else.

The holder of this tome has their ability
cooldowns shortened by 3 sec.

The wearer of this ring slowly regenerates
health at all times.

A crude but effective weapon.  Hope you've
had your shots!

A versatile and well-made blade, widely
used by Knights.

These were designed for chopping trees, not
for battle.

Bestows upon the wearer a +3 bonus to
attack power.

These rugged gauntlets provide a +6 power
bonus to the wearer.

Infused with the strength of demigods,
granting a +10 power bonus.

A magic-infused ring that grants +3 magic
power to its wearer.

This gemstone glistens with arcane fire.
Grants +6 magic power.

A powerful wizard's soul resides within the
crimson jewel... +10 magic power.

These nimble boots allow the wearer to run
10% faster.

The wearer of this amulet is granted rapid
health regeneration.

Provides a 10% chance for attacks to deflect
off of the wearer.

A field of energy protects the wearer of this
gem, negating 20% of attacks.

A symbol of strength and luck - grants a 15%
critical strike chance.

This eye-piece grants impossibly accurate
vision, and 10% critical chance.
This bracer grants an armor bonus of +3.

The bearer of this magic stone gains a +6
armor bonus.

The mighty soul of Sharkul lies within!
Increases armor by +10.

Grants the wearer astounding swiftness, 
increasing run speed by 20%.

Lucky!  Grants 5% critical strike chance to
your attacks.

Grants the wearer 5% increased attack or
casting speed.

The swirling energy of this jewel grants 10%
increased attack/cast speed.

Behold the blinding speed of the ninja!  +15%
attack/casting speed.

The secrets of this ancient text reduce the
owner's cooldowns by 6 sec.

Grants a 5% chance for an activated power
to invoke no cooldown.

Grants a 10% chance for an activated power
to invoke no cooldown.

Grants a 15% chance for an activated power
to invoke no cooldown.

While worn, the party will receive 10% extra
gold from battles.

While worn, the party will receive 20% extra
gold from battles.

Gives a bonus of +10% increased XP to the
owner.

What's inside? A baby dragon? Cream filling?
Grants +20% increased XP.

Once worn by bloodthirsty berserkers, grants
10% life-draining to attacks.

This vile fang grants the wearer a 20% life-
draining effect on their attacks.

Evil whispers emanate from the center jewel.
Grants 30% life-draining to attacks.

Popular among bare-fisted fighters, such as
the Monk.

Designed for freedom of movement, allowing
quick evasion.

Everyday lute strings, typically made from
intestine linings, ew!

Grants a 5% bonus to all healing received
by the wearer.

Grants a 10% bonus to all healing received
by the wearer.

Grants a 15% bonus to all healing received
by the wearer.

A finely crafted silver blade, from a well-
known smith.

Most likely the former property of some
ne're-do-well.

This blade hums with subtle magical energy
and light.

Blades such as these are said to be able to
slay spirits...

A relic from a lost civilization, it still holds
untold power.

A savage weapon made from the teeth and
bones of wyverns.
As deadly and remorseless as winter itself.

Each of this cursed blade's owners have
been driven mad.

Typically wielded in two hands... but not if
you're a hero.

Serrated and razor sharp - carves monsters
into bits!

Swords such as these are often forged by
by fey spirits.

The blade glistens with otherworldly light
and power.

Relic of the goddess, M'ir, vigilant protector
of all good souls.

This once evil blade has been cleansed by
holy rites.

These gloves provide increased punching
power.
Are these legal?  Probably not.

Few can withstand a blow from these cruel
implements.

A simple cloth that has been enchanted with
elemental magics.

Righteous fury fills these gloves with purpose
and power.

A relic from an ancient order of monks that
has since vanished.

Crafted by assassins, these gloves hold
murderous power.

Channels the might and fury of an ancient
imperial dynasty.

Not literally silver, but they shine with a
distinct luster.

These finely crafted strings provide superior
clarity and tone.

Imbued with subtle magic that enhances
their sound.

Grants an almost supernatural capacity to 
make the ladies swoon.

Dragons don't just make great wallets, but
also lute strings?

Their origin unknown, these strings create
unimaginable clarity.

These mysterious strings bear a curious aura
of sadness about them.

These strings resonate with the very soul of
all who hear them.

A popular choice amongst dual-wielding
barbarians.

These savage blades have a nasty serrated
edge.

Absurdly heavy stones on sticks - primitive
but effective.

Perfectly balanced, these axes are built for
combat.

Petrified by a supernatural chill, they strike
with immense force.

It is said the wounds these blades leave are
cursed to never heal.

Fashioned by dwarves, they exhibit long lost
crafstmanship.

Adorned with skulls, these towering swords
herald the end times.

Helps to channel divine power with greater
ease.

Crafted from the wood of ancient, blessed
groves.

Favored amongst scryers, these staves can
peer into the future.

A symbol of the holy circle of M'ir and its
high clerics.

Granted only to those who show great
compassion and piety.

The floating crystals that form this rod gently
hum with power.

This artifact is said to channel the very will
of the Sun King.

It's origin unknown, this artifact emits waves
of peace and calm.
Often confused with a simple walking stick.

These staves channel natural energies with
ease.
Chaotic energy swirls within the focus stone.

This staff appears to house a malevolent
spirit inside.

Exhibits exceptional capacity for channeling
the elements.
This staff bears a terrible, cursed aura.

This staff is fashioned in the image of a
serpent god.

These staves are only bestowed to the most
powerful of mages.

Turns the wearer into a walking tank... a very
slowly walking tank.

Crafted from the finest mithril, known for its
magical strength.
The sanctified armor of the Templar order.
Instills great courage in those who wear it.

Empowers the wearer with the strength of
100 fallen heroes.

Crafted by wood-folk, these cloaks are light-
weight and rugged.

Embroidered with runes and infused with
defensive magics.
It shimmers with an unnatural light.

Grants divine protection to those who are
steadfast and resolute.

Forbidden magic courses through the dark
fabric.

Reinforced with metal studs for added
protection.

This lightweight armor was inscribed by
clerics and mages.

Infuses the wearer with the crazed spirit of
the barbarian.

These dark clothes course with sinister,
shadowy magic.

None can stand against the unyielding force
of the blademaster.

Emblazoned with the image of a mighty
dragon spirit.

A symbol of one who has attained great skill
and respect.

Garments worn by the clan of the iron body,
masters of self defense.

Grants the wearer legendary swiftness and
skill.

Worn only by true masters of the martial
arts.

A simple bow used to hunt small game
animals.

This compact bow is easy to handle and
packs a punch.

Its design provides increased range and
power.

Fashioned from magical trees, this weapon
glows with energy.

Its lightweight, camouflaged design make it
ideal for assassins.

Crafted from the bone and tissues of a fallen
dragon.

These bows are typically only found in the
hands of elite royal snipers.

This weapon is engraved with elven songs
of war.

A bow said to house the force of 10,000
unrelenting storms.

partyDB.description:
A local mercenary, handy
with a dagger and 
morally flexible.  If the
job pays well, Gustav is
in.  He hopes to recieve
a royal pardon for his
extensive criminal record
by assisting you.

Don't let his age fool
you, Bromswell was an
adventurer in his day,
and a wizened master of 
the arcane arts.  While
technically retired, he's
still willing to lend his
skill to a worthy cause.

A traveler from the far
north, frost still clinging
to his beard, pelts and
scars adorn him.  His
weathered blades and
wildly gleaming eyes
speak of countless foes
slain...

An enigmatic sorceress,
distrusted by the locals.
Some believe she traded
her soul for the secrets
of dark magic.  Rumors
they may be, she is no
doubt a powerful
practitioner of forbidden
arts.

Member of an ancient
order from a distant
land. Their purpose - to
protect the innocent, and
hone both body and
spirit into the ultimate
weapon.  Evil creatures
flee at the sight of his
righteous fist!

A traveling minstrel who
inspires courage in all
who hear his music.  It
is said he was once a
Prince, but fate robbed
him of both his kingdom,
and his one true love.
He fights so that others
will not suffer as he has.

The only daughter of a
wealthy local merchant.  
To escape an arranged
marriage, she has fled
from her life of luxury
to pursue adventure,
and study the unladylike
art of combat.

An elven sorceress
hailing from the distant
southlands.  Her people
are both respected and
feared in these parts,
due in part to their
incomprehensible accent,
and the fearsome magic
they command.

No one is quite sure 
who he is, or from what
kingdom he hails.  Still,
none doubt his resilience
and strength.  There are
rumors that he once
survived having all of
his limbs dismembered.

A notorious pirate, he
once ruled the waters
of Doomvale until his
ship was destroyed by a
rampaging ninja.  He
hopes to one day exact
his revenge.

While his skills with a
bow are unparalleled,
he is perhaps the laziest
adventurer in all of
Haggerdom.  He was
supposed to be helping
the party months ago,
but apparently had
overslept.

A holy warrior who
combines healing magic
with impressive defense.
Her temper is short, and
her tongue is as sharp
as her blade... which has
claimed the heads of
countless trolls.

whichPower.description:
Instantly heal the entire party for a substantial
amount.

Protects your target, reducing their damage taken
by 75% for 10 sec.

Fills your target with holy might, doubling their
power for 10 sec.

Your auto-heals splash 30% of their total healing
to allies near your target.
Your auto-heals recover 15% more health.

The cleric is filled with divine purpose, doubling
healing power for 15 sec.

The cleric explodes with righteous fury, dealing
damage around them for 15 sec.

The recipient of your auto-heals has their power
increased by 15%.

Your auto-heals continue to heal the target over
time for 8 seconds.

While affected by Vengeful Angel or Guardian Angel,
the cleric is immune to damage.

Your auto-heals on others also heal you for 50%
of the healing done.
Your Group Heal spell recovers 25% more health.

Take on a defensive stance, reducing damage taken
by 50% for 15 sec.

Lash out with a series of whirling attacks at all
enemies around you.

The knight emits a terrible battle cry, forcing all
adjacent enemies to run in fear.
Your armor is increased by 15%.
Your power is increased by 15%.

Attracts the attention of all enemies, forcing them to
attack you instead of your allies.

A fierce rushing attack that knocks the enemy off
their feet.

Your normal attacks cripple the enemy, reducing
their damage by 10%.

Your normal attacks weaken your opponents armor,
increasing their damage taken by 10%.

Activating your War Cry or Shield Rush instantly
refreshes your other abilities.
Your Shield Wall lasts for 20 sec.

Your Shield Wall now reflects 100% of the damage
done to you, but lasts only 10 sec.
A precision strike that deals 250% normal damage.

Reveals flaws in your enemy's defenses, increasing
damage taken by 50% for 10 sec.

Hurls a poisoned knife at the target, dealing damage
over time.
Your attacks are 15% faster.

Your melee attacks have a 20% chance to deal
double damage.

Throws a knife coated in a toxin that renders its
victims helpless for 8 sec.

Warp behind your target and deliver a precision
strike for 350% normal damage.
Your armor is increased by 15%.
You now move 15% faster.

Your blades are permanently coated in paralytic
poison, randomly stunning your foes.

Your Sneak Attack and Shadowstep both deal 40%
more damage.
Your power is increased by 10%.

Summons a meteor on your target, dealing damage
in a large radius.

Chilling winds damage and slow all enemies on the
field for 10 sec.

All enemies are frozen in time, rendering them
helpless for 5 sec.

Your basic fireball attack deals 75% of its damage
to nearby targets.

Your basic fireball attack deals 20% increased
damage.

Your target is consumed with fire, dealing damage
and disabling them for 6 sec.

Lightning strikes the caster, dealing damage and
knocking away nearby foes.

Attacks made against you have a 20% chance to
launch a fireball back at the attacker.

All attacks against you have a 20% chance to phase
through you, doing no damage.
The Wizard can now teleport at will.

Your Meteor spell ignites its victims, dealing 50%
more damage over 8 sec.

Your Meteor spell knocks its victims to the ground
for 3 sec.

Dark magic that steals life from its victim, healing
the caster's most injured ally.

Unleashes toxic fumes in a large area, dealing
damage over time.

An enfeebling curse that greatly reduces its victim's
attack power for 10 sec.

Your basic shadowbolt attack deals 15% extra
damage.

All of your attacks heal you for 30% of the damage
dealt.

Fear consumes all enemies - the severity of the effect
increases with proximity to you.

Your target is turned into a toad for 6 sec., rendering
them weak and harmless.

Enemies who strike you have a 10% chance to be
consumed with fear.

Attacks against you have a 5% chance to reset the
cooldown on Drain Life.

Your Drain Life spell is increased in power against
foes who are feared, paralyzed or cursed.

Your Drain Life spell deals 40% additional damage,
but still heals for the same amount.

Your Drain Life spell recovers 40% additional health,
though its damage is not increased.

An invigorating song that instantly heals your
target.

The Bard's soothing melodies replenish the party's
health over time.

The entire party takes 25% less damage for 15 sec.
after hearing this tune.

The power bonus granted to your target is increased
by 50%.

The armor bonus granted to your target is increased
by 50%.

The Bard's music empowers the party, increasing
their damage by 25% for 15 sec.

The party is inspired in their darkest hour, resetting
all of their cooldowns.
Your healing songs are 25% more effective.

The lingering effects of your songs are extended by
5 seconds.

Your target's cooldowns refresh 20% faster while
under the effects of your Lute.

Your target's movement and attack/casting speeds
are increased by 10%.
Song of Renewal now effects the entire party.

Fly into a rage, increasing damage dealt AND taken
by 35% for 8 sec.

You become a human blur, attacking at a high rate
of speed for 10 sec.

You become a whirlwind of steel, striking out at
all adjacent targets.

The positive and negative effects of your Enrage
ability are increased by another 15%.
Being enraged no longer has any penalty.

A massive attack that deals damage to the barbarian
as well as his target.

Pounce on your target, dealing massive damage in
an area around them.

Your melee attacks have a 20% chance to deal
critical damage.

While enraged, the Barbarian gains an extra 75%
life-draining on all attacks.

After delivering the finish blow on an enemy, you
heal slightly and recieve a haste buff.

Your Reckless Blow/Savage Pounce also knock the
victim down.

Your Reckless Blow/Savage Pounce deal 20% more
damage.

With blinding speed, the Monk attacks everything on
the battlefield at once.

You become momentarily untouchable, evading all
attacks for 8 sec.

A shockwave of pure Ki erupts from the Monk,
knocking foes to the ground.

Your basic attacks have a 5% chance to knock
opponents to the ground.

Your basic attacks have a 15% chance to deal
critical damage.

Unleash a flurry of blows, dealing heavy damage to
a single target.

Enter a trance state, granting you increased speed
and health regen for 15 sec.
All healing effects on you are increased by 10%.
Your attack power is increased by 15%.

Whenever you take damage in melee, you have a
30% chance to instantly counterattack.

Your Wind Walk ability cripples foes, reducing their
movement speed for 6 sec.
Your Wind Walk ability deals 50% more damage.

A precisely aimed shot which deals more damage
the further away the target is.

Ignites the ground, dealing continuous damage to
enemies who remain in the blaze.

A poisoned arrow which deals continuous damage
and leaves the victim slowed.

Your attacks have an additional 15% critical strike
chance.

The Ranger's basic attacks deal grievous wounds,
reducing healing recieved by 75%.

Unleash a salvo of arrows that deals damage to
all enemies.

A brutal shot that throws its victim to the ground for
8 seconds.

Your Aimed Shot ability deals an additional 50%
damage.

Your special shots force their victims to attack your
most armored ally.

You've befriended a hunting dog, who automatically
attacks your target.

Your dog ally distracts and harasses your enemies,
reducing their damage by 15%.

Your dog companion becomes a whirlwind of terror,
dealing damage to all nearby enemies.

A wave of soothing light seeks out and heals your
most injured ally.

Imbues your sword with holy lightning for 10 sec.,
which chains to nearby foes.

Converts all damage taken into healing instead for
10 seconds.
Increases the paladin's armor by 15%.

Both movement and attack speed are increased by
10%.

Redirects all damage from the group to the paladin
for 10 seconds.

A blast of divine fury knocks all enemies to the
ground while healing the party.
Increases the paladin's maximum health by 20%.

The power of your healing abilities is increased by
20%.

The Paladin now grants 25% of their own armor
value to all of their allies.

Your Holy Word ability also leaves a lingering shield,
nullifying damage for 5 sec.

Holy Word now strengthens its target, boosting their
power by 50% for 10 seconds.

whichLevel.description:
Once a peaceful forest, it is now home to
goblins and other foul creatures.

Much of the kingdom's sprawling farmland
has been claimed by roving goblin hordes.

You've heard rumors of a huge cyclops that
roams these fields at sundown...

All that lies here are the sun-bleached
remains of an ancient culture.

The leader of the goblin horde makes his
home in this squalid wetland.

Few living souls have ventured across this
glade in recent years.

These once sacred grounds have been
defiled by necromancers.

Houses the remains of kings, heroes, and
more than a few adventurers.

These ruins echo quietly with the creaks and
clatters of walking skeletons.

The trees here are draped ominously with
disturbingly large spider webs...

The southern road leads directly through the
dank recesses of this unstable cave.

Test your might!  How long can you survive?
High Score:
No Description.
No Description.

This hostile ravine was a dangerous place
even before monsters moved in.

An arid, lifeless wasteland.  Why monsters
insist on living here is anyone's guess.

This cave is said to house living slimes that
can devour even the most stalwart hero.

Oozes and the living dead have defiled this
once proud forest.

Yet another shattered husk of a civilization,
now overgrown and lost to the ages.

Not even looters have dared to visit these
haunted grounds in recent years.

The walls of this cavern glisten with caustic
slime, and a foul smell hangs in the air...

As the moon rises over these silent sands,
the native wildlife comes out to hunt.

This winding pass seems to carve endlessly
into the rocky mountainside.

Powerful mountain giants have made their
home amidst the crimson rocks.

Test your might!  How long can you survive?
High Score:

A volcanic eruption has left the terrain here
scarred and lifeless.

An ancient stone golem stands vigilant here,
waiting for hapless adventurers to crush.
No Description.
No Description.
No Description.

The sky is clear, and the scent of the sea
hangs in the air.

This ancient thicket remains in a perpetual
state of winter year-round.

Brisk winter winds howl between the
crumbling columns of this necropolis.

Test your might!  How long can you survive?
High Score:

Unrelenting snow and ice have turned this
frigid land into a tomb.

Threatening growls echo from deep within
the icy depths.

The first of the invading monster hordes
emerged from beyond this very chasm.

A sign outside warns of certain death to
those who press on.

On the horizon lies a black citadel, shrouded
by volcanic fumes.

This wasteland is carpeted in the bones of
would-be heroes.

The Lord of the Dead awaits those foolish
enough to challenge him...
